notes: VAT 16% (Ordonnance-loi 10/001, art. 35); jewellery is excluded from the original-works-of-art exemption (art. 15) and no gold/bullion exemption exists in arts. 15-19, so jewellery and bullion are both 16%. Import duty (DGDA tariff) not readable - HS 7108 line not found on an openable page. No dealer bar list or buyback % found.

sources.name: Direction Générale des Impôts (dgi.gouv.cd) - Code des Impôts (updated 10 Jul 2023), Ordonnance-loi 10/001 art. 35
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 35 sets the normal VAT rate at 16% for all taxable operations; the Code reproduces OL 10/001 as amended - no gold/bullion exemption (replaces the leganet.cd copy, a private portal)
sources.quote: taux normal : 16% applicable à toutes les opérations imposables à l'exclusion des opérations soumises au taux réduit ou au taux zéro
